description: A read-only, agent-native CLI for Ignition proposals, invoices, billing, clients, and payments, with a local SQLite mirror and invoicing analytics the web UI does not offer.

novel_features.name: Outstanding-billing rollup
novel_features.description: See everything billed but not yet paid, summed per client.

novel_features.name: Proposal pipeline by status
novel_features.description: Count proposals across DRAFT, AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE, ACCEPTED, and LOST for the whole book of business.

novel_features.name: Per-client billing summary
novel_features.description: One client's full money picture: what was proposed, invoiced, and still outstanding.

novel_features.name: Unbilled work finder
novel_features.description: Surface accepted proposals that do not yet have a matching invoice or billing item.

novel_features.name: Rejected-payment watch
novel_features.description: List clients with a rejected or failed payment so collections can follow up.
